phases.message: I'm Teodora, I run shipping at Corbel Optics. Start in Labelyard: read every late or flagged parcel from the last three weeks and open each one, with its service, how it was tendered, its address and signature options, its scheduled delivery and when it really arrived.
Mailnest has our shipping inbox: customers' notes, the carriers' mail and anything else about these parcels. Read it all.

Wrenpost's portal. Read its service guide's money-back guarantee, its service alerts and our refund requests, then request a refund for every Wrenpost package the guarantee really covers, for the right amount. Don't claim one the guarantee doesn't cover.

Lanecourier's portal. Read its terms, our invoices and the credits already on them, and claim every refund its guarantee owes us. Then tell me what you claimed, what's due next, and what you left alone and why.

wrenpost_guide.text: Today is Friday 9 October 2026. Wrenpost Service Guide 2026: the Wrenpost money-back guarantee. Topics: services, suspended, window, exceptions, refund.

The money-back guarantee applies to Wrenpost Next Morning (by 10:30 am), Wrenpost Next Day (by 3:00 pm to a commercial address, end of day to a residence) and Wrenpost Two Day AM (by 10:30 am, commercial addresses only: Two Day AM to a residential address carries no guarantee). A package is late when delivery is first attempted more than 60 seconds after its scheduled time.

Until further notice, the money-back guarantee is suspended for Wrenpost Ground, Wrenpost Two Day and Wrenpost Three Day: their delivery dates are estimates and no refund is given for a late delivery.
Request the refund within 15 calendar days of the package's scheduled delivery date. Only the payer may request it. A request after 15 days is declined.

No refund when the delay comes from causes beyond Wrenpost's control, including weather, natural disasters, acts of public authority and disruptions announced in a service alert; an incorrect or incomplete address, including a missing suite or apartment number; a package tendered after the pickup cut-off or outside business hours; a recipient unavailable or refusing to sign where a signature is required; or a delivery change the recipient asked for.

Wrenpost refunds or credits the transportation charge for the late package only, not the fuel surcharge or any accessorial charge (address correction, residential, signature). One refund per package. This is the sole remedy for a late delivery.

lanecourier_terms.text: Today is Friday 9 October 2026. Lanecourier Service Terms 2026: the Lanecourier money-back guarantee. Topics: services, suspended, window, exceptions, refund.

The money-back guarantee applies to Priority Overnight (by 10:30 am), Standard Overnight (by 4:30 pm to a business) and Lane 2Day AM (by 10:30 am). A service failure is a delivery 60 seconds or more after the published delivery commitment. A package picked up on a Friday without Saturday delivery is committed for the next business day, Monday.
The money-back guarantee remains suspended until further notice for Lane Ground, Lane Home, Lane 2Day and Lane Saver: there are no delivery commitments on them, and no refund for a late delivery.
Claim within 15 calendar days of the date of the invoice the package is billed on (accounts billed on invoice). Only the payer may claim. A claim after that is declined.

No refund for: weather, acts of God or other causes beyond Lanecourier's control; an incorrect address or ZIP code; the unavailability or refusal of a person to accept delivery or sign for the package where a signature is required; a package tendered after the location's cut-off time, whose commitment moves to the next business day; a package rerouted or held at the recipient's request; or a package delivered on time.

Lanecourier refunds or credits the transportation charge for the late package only, not the fuel surcharge or other surcharges. One refund or credit per package: a package already credited is not credited again.
